english.title: Person requested to leave re-enter airport within 24 hours without authorisation - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having left the Liverpool John Lennon Airport when requested to do so by

(A)_[a constable,]_
(B)_[an airport official,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY NAME..), unlawfully re-entered the airport within 24 hours of the request
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 3(12) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
english.pointstoprove: date and locationhaving left the Liverpool John Lennon Airport when requested to do sore-entered the airportwithin 24 hoursother than under the written authorisation given by the constable OR airport official who issued the original request to leave OR in their absence the airport company

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Byelaw 1(3) states that the offence will not be committed by any member of a fire, police or ambulance service acting in the course of their duty or to any emergency vehicle being used by such a person.(ii) Nothing in byelaw 3(11) prejudices the operation of other byelaws pertaining to the removal or evacuation of persons from Liverpool John Lennon Airport.
